image_description: A close-up, front-facing portrait of a bison against a stark white background. The image focuses on the head, prominent shoulder hump, and upper torso. The bison has dark brown, shaggy fur, particularly dense around the head and shoulders, with lighter brown fur on the lower visible body. Two curved horns extend outward and upward. A blurry foreground element (possibly grass or rock) obscures the very bottom edge.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the frame. The horns are present, curved, and appear proportionally short compared to the massive bulk of the head and shoulders.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a distinct, dense mass of longer, darker hair hanging from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
Both eyes are visible, dark in color, and symmetrically placed.
The ears are small and partially obscured by the thick surrounding fur, matching the biological description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows significant mass and height at the shoulders (withers), creating the characteristic bison silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is clearly shaggy and dark brown. The shoulder hump is the most prominent structural feature in the upper body.
The image is cropped at the mid-torso; the hindquarters are completely outside the frame and cannot be evaluated.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Reiterating the head checkpoint: the horns are substantial but visually shorter than the width/height of the massive head and shoulder block.
The legs and hooves are entirely below the crop line and not visible.
The rear of the animal is not visible in this frontal portrait crop.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight 'haloing' or softness where the fine hairs meet the pure white background. Some individual hair strands appear to merge slightly into the background rather than having crisp separation, typical of AI generation diffusion boundaries.

The left horn (viewer's right) appears slightly thicker at the base and curves differently than the right horn. While asymmetry exists in nature, the lighting and thickness feel slightly inconsistent with a perfectly frontal pose.

To verify the structural integrity of the head, neck, and shoulder connection, ensuring no fusion artifacts.
To specifically audit the 'haloing' artifact observed at the fur/background boundary for segmentation leaks.
To assess the realism of the fur texture and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Fur texture realism and strand definition
Boundary sharpness between fur and white background
